text: 65वें मिनट में Seabrook Town ने ज़्यादा आगे प्रेस करना और सीधे गेंद चलाना शुरू किया ताकि हार से बचा जा सके। उनकी दबाव और लाइन की ऊंचाई दोनों बढ़ गई, लेकिन इससे अच्छे मौके बनाने की संभावना (xG) कम हो गई, मतलब गोल करने के चांस थोड़े घट गए[#1361]. Harbour City ने आराम से अपनी रक्षा कर ली और Seabrook Town के हमले को ज्यादा खतरनाक नहीं होने दिया[#1361].

- Seabrook Town increased their press from 0.66 to 0.84 after the tactical change at 65' [#1361].  
- Directness of play for Seabrook Town rose from 0.42 to 0.57 following the change [#1361].  
- Seabrook Town's defensive line height increased from 0.6 to 0.72 post-change [#1361].  
- Despite changes, Seabrook Town's xG dropped from 0.78 before to 0.46 after the change [#1361].  
- Opponent (Harbour City) xG increased slightly from 0.03 to 0.14 after Seabrook Town's tactical shift [#1361].

- Seabrook Town altered their tactics at 65' to press higher up the pitch and play more direct, reflecting an urgent push to chase the game while trailing 2-1 [#1361]. This is shown by increased pressing (press from 0.66 to 0.84), a higher defensive line (line_height from 0.6 to 0.72), and greater directness in attack (directness from 0.42 to 0.57).  
- Despite the tactical shift, Seabrook's xG actually decreased from 0.78 before the change to 0.46 afterward, indicating that while they attempted a more aggressive approach, it was less effective in creating quality chances in the short term [#1361].  
- The move to press higher and play more direct suits their 3-4-3 formation and wide, crossing style, as pushing up the pitch and direct passing can exploit their wingbacks and wide attackers for crossing opportunities; however, the lower field tilt percentage after the change (dropping from 70% to 48%) suggests they lost territorial dominance [#1361].  
- Harbour City, set up in a 4-2-3-1 and playing patient short passing, maintained a solid defensive shape under increased pressure, limiting Seabrook’s box touches (dropping from 11 to 9 after the change) and keeping a low xG conceded (rising only slightly from 0.03 to 0.14), reflecting effective resistance to Seabrook’s high press and direct attacks [#1361].
